# Acadia Care (Acadia Support Services Limited)

> CQC registered domiciliary care provider based at Whittle Rise, Staffordshire Technology Park, Stafford, ST18 0ES. Caring for people across Stafford and Staffordshire since 2013.

Acadia Care supports adults of all ages to live well at home. Services include visiting care (from 30 minutes), live-in and 24-hour care, overnight care, respite, nurse led and clinical care (PEG feeding, stoma, catheter, wound care, IV medication support), dementia, palliative and end of life care, learning disability and autism support, supported living, household help, and healthcare staffing (support workers, care assistants, senior carers, RGN and RMN nurses) for care organisations. Self funded, Local Authority and NHS Continuing Healthcare funding are accepted.

- Phone: 07949 720 932 (24/7 emergency line)
- Email: care@acadiacare.co.uk
- CQC profile: https://www.cqc.org.uk/location/1-8530909595
- Reviews: https://portal.homecare.co.uk/index.cfm/id/65432250790
